title: Reading Drill — Comparing footbridge materials — Preparing a second trial
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Comparing footbridge materials — Preparing a second trial
passages.body:
**A** In Brackenton, work on bridge surfaces becoming smooth after repeated use had already produced a small collection of portable slip tests. The bridge technician used this material to plan a second trial. The first report contained several different figures, but for the second trial the group agreed to publish one main outcome: surface grip.

**B** The group kept a textured deck coating for the new trial, which was planned to run for six weeks. Volunteers were shown a sample record before starting. They were also asked to describe anything unusual in a separate note, so later readers could tell the difference between an ordinary value and one taken during a disruption.

**C** The trial design stated that mud on footwear should be recorded even when everything else appeared normal. If this information was missing, the team would leave the field blank rather than infer an answer. It would publish a provisional finding and label it clearly if too few readings were available for a reliable result.
